name: Inside Leviathan
source:
After being swallowed by the ancient progenitor demon, Leviathan, the human explorer, Edda and the torrential archdemon, Azhur must team up if they wish to escape the beast. Inside Leviathan is a short kinetic visual novel about this odd human-demon duo — follow their journey as they work together to bust open the jaws of a significantly more powerful demon and reclaim their freedom. Will they make it out unharmed?

[From [url=https://woodaster.itch.io/inside-leviathan-preview]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在被远古始祖恶魔利维坦、人类探险家埃达和洪流大恶魔吞噬后，阿祖尔如果想逃离这头野兽，就必须联手。《利维坦内部》是一部简短的动态视觉小说，讲述了这对奇怪的人类与恶魔二人组的故事——跟随他们的旅程，他们共同努力，撕开一个更强大的恶魔的嘴，并夺回自由。他们能安然无恙吗？

[来自[url=https://woodaster.itch.io/inside-leviathan-preview]Itch.io[/url]]
